shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '72,75p' src/App.tsx && ls node_modules/@playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium || which google-chrome || true"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace('</option value=\"utc\">','</option><option value=\"utc\">')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run build
npm ls @playwright/test playwright puppeteer --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's#</option value=\"utc\">#</option><option value=\"utc\">#g' src/App.tsx
npm run build
ls /tmp /usr/bin | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/forma-libs /tmp/forma-debs
cd /tmp/forma-debs
apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libexpat1 libxcb1 libx11-6 libxext6 libxrender1 libpixman-1-0 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libharfbuzz0b libfribidi0 libthai0 libwayland-server0 libgraphite2-3 libdatrie1
for file in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" /tmp/forma-libs; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg '"'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/forma-debs
apt-get download libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3 libpng16-16 libxcb-shm0 libxcb-render0 libxi6
for file in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" /tmp/forma-libs; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/forma-check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/forma-debs
apt-get download fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core
for file in fontconfig-config*.deb fonts-dejavu-core*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" /tmp/forma-libs; done
mkdir -p /tmp/forma-fontcache
cat > /tmp/forma-fonts.conf <<'"'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/forma-libs/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/forma-fontcache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/forma-fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/forma-check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/forma-debs
apt-get download libsqlite3-0
dpkg-deb -x libsqlite3-0*.deb /tmp/forma-libs
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/forma-fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/forma-libs/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/forma-libs/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/forma-check.mjs'
